summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd), alone and with other anticancer drugs, in adults with advanced or metastatic solid tumours, including endometrial, gastric, prostate, ovarian, colorectal, urothelial, and biliary tract cancers. Dato-DXd is given by intravenous (IV) infusion, and some study arms add oral capecitabine, oral prednisone/prednisolone, or other IV drugs; how long or how often is not stated. The record does not state a main outcome measure, but the study aims to look at safety, tolerability, and anti-tumour activity.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa el datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd), solo y con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos, incluidos los cánceres endometrial, gástrico, de próstata, de ovario, colorrectal, urotelial y de vías biliares. El Dato-DXd se administra por infusión intravenosa (IV), y algunos grupos del estudio agregan capecitabina oral, prednisona/prednisolona oral u otros medicamentos IV; la duración o la frecuencia no están indicadas. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal, pero el estudio busca evaluar la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la actividad antitumoral.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with documented advanced or metastatic cancer
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 with no decline in the 2 weeks before dosing
Must provide a tumour sample for tissue analysis
At least one measurable lesion not previously irradiated (prostate substudy allows non-measurable bone disease)
not_for: Prior treatment with TROP2-directed therapy or an antibody-drug conjugate with a deruxtecan payload
Brain metastases or spinal cord compression, unless treated
History of non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis that needed steroids
Active hepatitis B or C, or uncontrolled infection needing IV treatment
